questions.q: The function to be maximised or minimised in a linear programming problem is called the ____.
questions.explanation: It is the quantity we want to optimise.

questions.q: The feasible region is the set of points that ____.
questions.explanation: Every constraint must hold at each of its points.

questions.q: Where does the optimal value of the objective function occur?
options: At a corner point of the feasible region
At the centre of the region
questions.explanation: This is the corner point theorem.

questions.q: For Z = 3x + 4y, the corner points are (0, 0), (2, 0) and (0, 3). What is the maximum value of Z?

options: has both a maximum and a minimum
questions.explanation: A linear function over a bounded region attains both extremes.
